# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 13 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB & BTO Updates

- **November BTO draws over 35,600 applications, two-room flats most competitive** - The November BTO exercise attracted more than 35,600 applications, the highest rate since 2022, with two-room flats recording the most competition among flat types. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-bto-draws-35600-applications-two/)

- **February 2027 BTO launch previewed across four estates** - HDB's February 2027 BTO exercise is set to offer around 4,300 flats in Bishan, Toa Payoh, Tampines and Tengah, with a site-by-site review of expected prices and demand published. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/review-february-2027-bto-launch-sites/)

## Private Residential Market

- **Lentor area now has 3,400 new homes; early Lentor Modern buyers averaged $314K gain** - Across all seven new Lentor condos, early buyers at Lentor Modern made an average of $314,000, with the article covering land prices, sales volumes, sub-sale gains and rental performance across the cluster. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/lentor-moderns-early-buyers-made-312k-on-average-how-all-7-new-lentor-condos-have-done-so-far-2/)

- **Two adjoining GCBs near Botanic Gardens listed at $53M combined** - Two freehold Good Class Bungalows at 15 and 15A Camden Park in District 11 are available via Expression of Interest at $26M and $27M respectively, offered separately or as a pair. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-side-side-bungalow-plots-near/)

## Commercial & Institutional Deals

- **Foreign groups in deals worth up to $11B for Singapore landmark buildings** - Hongkong Land and IOI are acquiring some of Singapore's best-known commercial buildings in transactions that could total approximately $11 billion, reflecting continued foreign institutional appetite for Singapore assets. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-marquee-assets-having-moment-year/)
